author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.22 shipped: HVAC: plain names for presence-wait and weather-adjust settings, zone away and arrester countdowns published, pre-cool restore uses Heat Low
summary: HVAC: plain names for presence-wait and weather-adjust settings, zone away and arrester countdowns published, pre-cool restore uses Heat Low
why: Batch A of the consolidated HVAC W1/W2 finish. The operator asked for plain labels (the consensus defer gate and settle time names meant nothing) and for zone-away and arrester countdowns on the v8 dashboard; the countdown values were computed but never published, so the dashboard could only estimate them. The restore fallback bug (cool minus 7 instead of the configured Heat Low) would heat an empty winter zone to about 73 F. The planned HIGH-1 manual-skip deletion was dropped because the skip is still reachable after a restart during a compromise (C26).
implications: Shipped HVAC-PRECOOL-RESTORE-HEAT-MINUS7-1, HVAC-PUBLISH-ZONE-AWAY-DUE-AND-ARRESTER-TIMERS-1 at v5.103.22; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.22.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If away_due_at disagrees with the actual exit write time, or a restore writes a heat value that is not the configured Heat Low

refs.release_notes: Renames: Wait for Presence, Compliance Presence Wait, Weather Adjust Delay, Weather Adjust Margin (entity ids unchanged). New display attributes: away_due_at on each HVAC zone status sensor; grace_until and compromise_until per zone on the arrester. Pre-cool/pre-heat restore fallback now uses the configured Heat Low instead of cool minus 7.
